## Security consideration

Every feature in ThreadRunner is evaluated against the [security model](../../SECURITY.md). Please address:

- Does this add a new inbound event type or widen an authorization path?
- Does this introduce a new CLI tool, file access, or network capability?
- Does it persist or transmit sensitive data?
- What is the default-deny behavior when validation fails?
